findings.claim: 1956 industrial policy divided industries into three categories with different public/private roles
findings.locator: Exhibit 1, paragraph 6-10, printed pp 2-3, PDF pages 1-2
findings.precision: Schedule A exclusively state future development subject to specified exceptions; Schedule B progressively state-owned with private supplementation; other industries generally private initiative; state could still enter.

findings.claim: 1956 policy assigned every industry exclusively to the public sector
1956 Schedule A included iron and steel, coal/lignite, railway transport and electricity generation/distribution
1956 policy did not acknowledge private-sector cooperation in Schedule A industries
findings.precision: Conditional cooperation permitted where national interests required; monopoly carve-outs specifically enumerated.
